what: Cold rust-analyzer 1.99.1 (58cf8f9 2026-10-13) on the tool-smoke rust fixture (tests/fixtures/tool-smoke/rust, one deliberate E0308 type mismatch). Every figure under productPath is the wall time of ONE cold lsp_touch_file through the production path (the smoke seam; the lsp_diagnostics route is under lspDiagnosticsRoute and caught the error more often) (spawn + initialize + didOpen + pull), a fresh scratch project and a fresh PI_LENS_HOME per run, on an idle 32-core host (load ~4.6). The CI runner and a CPU-starved host were NOT measured for rust.
toolchain: rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13), cargo 1.99.1 (5f94df478 2026-08-27), rust-analyzer 1.99.1 (58cf8f9 2026-10-13) from the rustup `rust-analyzer` component (minimal profile, stable), found on PATH by the server's cargoBinCandidates rung; ensureTool's managed download was not used.
rowProvenance: The `rust-analyzer` row (3000 / 500 / expectSemanticSecondPush) came in with commit 3bf9ff93b (2026-05-04), whose message lists it as a design value (`TS=1000ms/0ms/no, rust-analyzer=3000ms/500ms/yes`) with no measurement. The key never matched the registry id `rust`, so it never applied.

rawPull.command: JSON-RPC probe (not shipped): spawn rust-analyzer in a fresh copy of the fixture, initialize, didOpen, then textDocument/diagnostic every 100 ms until a report with items. Times are ms from spawn.
rawPull.reportsSeen: items:[] (an authoritative empty report) at 24-365 ms, then a null reply (ContentModified-style) at ~0.7-3.2 s, then the finding

lspDiagnosticsRoute.source: PR #5486 review r1 (not the fixer's runs): pilens_diagnostics {source:"lsp", scope:"paths"} through the built MCP server (the lsp_diagnostics agent tool), rust-analyzer 1.99.1, a fresh project copy and a fresh pinned HOME per run, same idle host.

productPath.command: node scripts/smoke-tools.mjs --lsp --verbose rust (dist built from the head under test); touchMs is `lsp_touch_file` durationMs in latency.log, collected is metadata.collectedDiagnostics. A row is the strategy the build carried: aggregateWaitMs / pullRetryBudgetMs.
